title: `InputRequiredResult`
description: The multi round-trip mechanism by which a server asks for more input mid-request, answered by the client retrying with `inputResponses` and the server's `requestState` under a new request id.
question: Can the framework complete a request that needs a second round trip?
why: New in 2026-07-28, and it is now the only way a server can ask the client for anything: server-initiated requests were removed outright. Elicitation, sampling and roots all arrive through this envelope, so a framework that cannot retry with `inputResponses` cannot use any of them, no matter what it declares.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1 calls tools through the MCP SDK's default `call_tool`, which raises on an `InputRequiredResult` instead of retrying, and the adapter exposes neither `allow_input_required` nor an input handler. No embedded request, elicitation or otherwise, is answered.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): the client throws on any `resultType: "input_required"` result ("Server requested additional input, but multi round-trip requests are not supported yet") and never retries, so no embedded request is answered, even with `onElicitationRequest` registered.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0: every `input_required` result goes unanswered. The client's automatic fulfilment needs a handler registered on the MCP client, and the SDK neither registers one nor lets the caller register one.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` has no elicitation handler, so an `input_required` result is never answered; the call fails with `Elicitation not supported`.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy answers no `input_required` itself. The round trip completes only because the caller's `mcp.Client` carries an `elicitation_callback`, which DSPy never configures.
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): the runtime retries an `input_required` result for a form-mode elicitation, answered through `SessionConfig.onElicitationRequest`. A URL-mode request fails to parse and the call fails (see elicitation-url-mode). Sampling requests get the same cancelled answer as at 2025-11-25. `roots/list` fails the call with "requested unsupported input method: roots/list".
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: at 2026-07-28 `DefaultMcpClient` reads an `InputRequiredResult` and throws `Server sent inputRequests that the client cannot handle`, whatever is embedded. No hook answers it, so the tool call fails.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): go-sdk retries an `input_required` result through the handlers set on the caller's `*mcp.Client` (`mcptoolset.Config.Client`): sampling and form- and URL-mode elicitation are answered. An embedded `roots/list` fails to decode (see roots-list). mcptoolset itself has no input option.
